Step Number: 5
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the gathered evidence by conflating Pamela B. Green’s motion graphics/title design work with being “known for animation,” while overlooking the clear evidence that Levni (Lev) Yilmaz is explicitly known for animation (Tales of Mere Existence).
